parameters.query:
=SELECT ni.title AS titel, ni.published_at, ni.created_at, na.betroffene_ticker_json,
       na.wirkungsebene, na.wirkungsrichtung, na.wirkung_staerke,
       na.ticker_begruendung, na.wirkungs_begruendung
FROM trading.news_assessments na
JOIN trading.news_items ni ON ni.id = na.news_id
WHERE na.relevant = TRUE AND na.wirkung_staerke = 'hoch'
  AND (ni.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date;
